# function: cuedecode

Parses and evaluates one or more [CUE](https://cuelang.org/) expression strings, unifying them together and returning the result as a native Terraform value. When multiple arguments are provided, they are unified (merged with constraint checking) in order. This allows applying inline constraints or overrides to loaded CUE configurations.

```hcl
# Simple decode
provider::util::cuedecode(file("config.cue"))

# With inline constraints
provider::util::cuedecode(file("config.cue"), <<CUE
  port: >1024
  name: =~"^[a-z]+$"
CUE
)
```



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
cuedecode(cue string, constraints string...) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `cue` (String) The primary CUE expression string to evaluate.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `constraints` (Variadic, String) Additional CUE expressions to unify with the primary value. Useful for applying constraints or merging configurations.
